entry.title: New: Resolution 31 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE, PURSUANT TO HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7

Allows for the receipt of $135,000 to assist coffee farmers by offsetting the cost of the insecticide used to control the Coffee Berry Borer and/or approved fungicides to control Coffee Leaf Rust.
